heading: Computation and certification of account benefit ratios

tree.heading: Initial computation and certification
tree.text: On or before November 1, 2003, the Railroad Retirement Board shall—

children.text: compute the account benefits ratios for each of the most recent 10 preceding fiscal years, and
certify the account benefits ratios for each such fiscal year to the Secretary of the Treasury.

tree.heading: Computations and certifications after 2003
tree.text: On or before November 1 of each year after 2003, the Railroad Retirement Board shall—

children.text: compute the account benefits ratio for the fiscal year ending in such year, and
certify the account benefits ratio for such fiscal year to the Secretary of the Treasury.

tree.heading: Definition
tree.text: As used in this section, the term “account benefits ratio” has the meaning given that term in section 3241(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 [26 U.S.C. 3241(c)].
